title: Lake Cocibolca and Ometepe: a freshwater sea with two volcanoes
goal: Explain why Lake Cocibolca and the island of Ometepe are special, with porque and por eso.
grammar: giving reasons and results with porque and por eso (review)

sections.title: Lake Cocibolca and Ometepe: a freshwater sea with two volcanoes
body: In this lesson you read about Lake Cocibolca (also called Lake Nicaragua), the island of Ometepe and its two volcanoes. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for giving a reason and a result: *porque* and *por eso*.

items: I can give a reason with *porque* and a result with *por eso*.
I can explain why Lake Cocibolca was called a sea.
I can say why the island of Ometepe has the shape of an eight.
